wins: Systematically mapped all accessible target hosts and recorded service banners during the reconnaissance window, ensuring a comprehensive attack surface view.
Maintained consistent mentor engagement (10 calls) to verify situational awareness and keep actions aligned with training objectives.
fails: Unable to achieve mission success because all exploitation attempts stalled before privilege escalation, indicating gaps in exploiting identified services.
Did not progress past the defensive perimeter despite high reward, suggesting incorrect sequencing of attack activities.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough and well-documented, but execution stalled before exploitation and privilege escalation, requiring refinement of attack sequencing.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploit attempts on discovered services repeatedly aborted before completing privilege escalation, often due to missing preconditions or timing issues.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts to validate supported binaries and authentication methods

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB shares list anonymous access
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate share contents and check for writable directories before deploying any tooling

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial reconnaissance discovers web application endpoints
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted enumerations (dirb, nikto) to identify configuration weaknesses before exploitation

memory_ops.reason: High effectiveness during initial reconnaissance to capture SSH service details.
Consistent coverage of SMB share reconnaissance improved visibility and readiness.

next_experiments.title: Chain reconnaissance findings into exploit phase
next_experiments.description: After enumerating services, immediately queue vulnerability checks and exploit attempts focusing on the highest-confidence targets (e.g., vulnerable SMB/SSH builds) to ensure momentum toward privilege escalation.

next_experiments.title: Introduce timed exploitation retries
next_experiments.description: Implement controlled retry logic with updated payloads when initial exploit attempts fail, minimizing setup time while avoiding redundant scans.

next_experiments.title: Validate automation of reconnaissance-to-exploitation handoff
next_experiments.description: Script the transition from scanning outputs to targeted exploits to reduce manual delay and maintain pressure on the defensive surface.
